reviews.review_description: Good price and quality  brand, with short waiting period  for the installation.

I am very unhappy with VicSolar.  Before getting paid they promised ongoing support service.  They promoted themselves as the biggest Solar installer. But they were always difficult to contact and over time ceased to be contactable at all.  Another business on their phone number and the email looks good on facebook but the only thing is... it doesnt work.  They became contactable again when the government offered a new rebate, but after that, they are again uncontactable.  The equipment has been ok so I am not complaining about that. Luckily there has not been a problem needing attention as I know I would not get any.  The problem is with the non existent service of this company.

Sales person was fantastic, product is good, install team Fantastic. But after sales Customer service is hopeless/useless, they said They will take care of connecting us to the Grid, 6-8 weeks after the Inspector visited we where told by AGL, Vic Solar still did not send in the required Paper work for us to be on the grid to make it worse when I FINALLY was able to get through to the Admin team I was told they had misplaced the paper work all except for the initial contract. They are also hopeless with getting back to you when they say they will, they didn't even offer an apology for their Lack of Professionalism. Sad that a good product is being let down by a very bad Admin/Customer service team.

$18,000 system$6,500 per year repayments$208 yr feed in generated3% of electricity usage reductionSystem will take 90 years to pay for itself at this rate.We were lead to believe the 21 panels were enough to cover our electricity usage avg 24kw/h, plus extra to reduce the growing power company debt from last few years.We were also led to believe we would not be affected by power outages, as the solar would power us. Since then, we have learnt that the battery would be needed for this and this $18,000 system does not include battery.
Do not buy off them. The owner won't answer calls. They were unlicensed in NSW to operate. Wont call us back.

Got a quote from a salesman at the door selling to Community Buy $12,765....did the talk and the push, must sign tonight.....I wanted to do some research so we said we'll think about it so he left....20 minutes later he called and claimed he got us a better deal as he spoke to his manager $7890.....I was reluctant (who gives you such a discount) but he worked on my husband and we signed and paid a deposit.......I wasn't happy so I started to get other quotes......all were cheaper and close to the same amount but I found a company that sold the exact same system as the one we were quoted on by the door salesman (even though he declared that his company was exclusive) for half the price, amazing.....We went with Vicsolar, the system is called Onesolar.....Have 12 panels instead of the 10 we were quoted on, sounds like a good 3kW. Inverter for $5150.......Insulation was on time, quick and clean but it took 2 months to get paperwork through to have it up and running...I chose to use my right of having 10 days cooling period, cancelled the original contract and it took a month to get back the refund of my deposit.......Now it's a matter to see how well the system will performHope this information will be helpful to someone else......Thank you for the opportunity
System had to be moved and changed 3 times. The whole process took over 1 year.

Initially I were happy to invest the money ($20,000) into solar but having now purchased and had it installed I am not seeing the benefits financially of solar. A rebate of 6c-7c per kW makes the investment a waste of time. I still receive electricity bills each month which are basically the same as prior to solar...plus the burden of the initial $20,000 investment.I were expecting my bills to be considerably lower (obviously) and the system to basically pay for itself which is not the case.A complete waste of time and money if you ask me...P.S If you have any tips at all to maximise my solar investment I would love to hear from you.
They Promise the world, tell you the repayments will be covered by the savings. Buyer beware!!! Savings don't even come close. They are over you to get a sale and then rude when you follow them up.

Don't recommend this supplier just like comment already made, sales rep promised the world and hasn't delivered. Now stuck with paying electricity bills and the panels!I regret not checkibg out the reviews before buying!Wish I'd got what was promised in writing.
Ensure get a number of quotes before making a purchase decision.

I had my panels installed by Vic Solar back in April and discovered in October that I wasn't put on the grid.....6 MONTHS LATER. After my enquiry they emailed the paperwork through to my electricity supplier. In November my electricity supplier imforms me some of my paper work has expired. So now it has to be resubmitted.  So still not up and running and it's nearly Christmas.  I have been paying off the panels, which was meant to be what i saved on my electricity bill. I have been paying off the panels and also electricity bills.  Vic Solar said they would show me the original email which they sent to Red Energy, but they have failed to show me. I don't believe they informed Red Energy, to have my house put on the grid. So not happy and i guess they won't compensate me for their mistake. I was looking at buying another house next year and was going to get them to put solar on again. But unless i get some sort of compensation,  they have lost my business. We are only human and would be nice if they admitted their mistake!

A nice sales person who promised the world and delivered none of it. 3 months later,  we are stuck with a hideous looking product that only generates 8kwh and no one returning any of our calls. Once they get their money,  you can say goodbye to customer service.   Make sure you get what the sales person says down in writing.

I originally wanted a 5kW system but it was important I could not see the panels (council regulations) and I could only fit 14 panels because the sales guy did not measure the roof...he just guessed.  That was disappointing as they should have been more thorough

My brother also went with the same company for a special deal(?) They were installed by separate teams, His was excellent, I had to recall them to fix a very poor cabling/ducting job which although legal looked very ordinary. This was done within a week but only because we had not paid the full amount until it was done. Otherwise we are happy with what we got. Still waiting on the Electricity company to do it's part!
